packageRules.description: Stay on Jersey 2.x: 3.x+ switched to jakarta.ws.rs (this code uses javax.ws.rs) and 4.x is compiled for JDK 17+, while this module builds on JDK 8/11 — a major bump is a jakarta+JDK migration, not an auto-bump, and throws UnsupportedClassVersionError at test runtime. Minor/patch within 2.x still flow. Remove only together with that migration.
